correctness.rationale: Nonnegative ordered Tonelli integrals and the finite hypergeometric Poisson Laplace transform give exact denominators and divergence. Discrete concavity reduces integrability to the last index; strict convexity creates the pure/mixed gap. Fixed-order Taylor coefficients yield the critical scaling; 817 exact-arithmetic cases and four off-boundary finite-parameter asymptotic evaluations independently corroborate the analytic proof. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The physically natural interpolation of fractional resetting and uniformly selected batches generates a strict, explicit intermittency gap between distinct-coordinate fluctuations and the single-coordinate even moment of the same total degree. Its all-order phase boundary and near-critical weak-reset law are not routine moment recomputations: they establish a qualitative separation with direct implications for collective-versus-marginal measurement of stochastic particles.
